messages:
customer: Hi, getting a 400 from the OCR tool when sending image bytes from our TS client. Error: "schema validation failed: field 'image' expected string". Python call works.
jane: thanks — can you share the request_id and a sanitized payload?
customer: request_id=rc_20240509_2f7e. Sent payload: {"tool":"ocr","args":{"image":new Uint8Array(...)}} (they pasted the raw array).
alex: that shape explains it — gateway is receiving array of ints instead of a base64 string. Which SDK versions?
jane: TS v1.4.1, Python v1.4.1, Go v1.4.1. Customer confirms only TS fails.
maria: TS historically maps typed arrays differently. TS should base64-encode Buffers/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray. Looks like a regression.
ryan: likely serializer turned TypedArray -> JSON array. Quick repro for us: client.callTool('t', { img: new Uint8Array([137,80,78,71]) }) -> JSON: {"img":[137,80,78,71]} expected "iVBORw0KGg==". I'll reproduce locally and patch.
jane: customer provided gateway body: {"tool":"ocr","args":{"image":[137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10,0,0,0,13,...]}}
alex: yep, serializer is the culprit. Workaround for Node: const b64 = Buffer.from(fs.readFileSync('id.png')).toString('base64'); client.callTool('ocr', { image: b64 })

maria: for browsers: const b64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(file))).client.callTool('ocr', { image: b64 }) — include snippet in docs.
ryan: patch plan: detect Buffer/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray -> base64; detect already-base64 strings to avoid double-encoding; add unit + integration tests (typedarray, Buffer, nested structures). Opening branch fix/ts-typedarray-serialize and ticket INC-4532.
maria: add changelog entry and SDK docs snippet; mark for hotfix.
ryan: PR incoming today, aim to cut 1.4.2 once CI + reviews pass.
jane: customer applied Buffer workaround and confirmed it unblocked them. Asking ETA — we can tell them 1-2 business days.
alex: agree. Support-bot: Action assigned -> INC-4532 (eng-interop) | severity: medium | affected: TS SDK binary toolcalls
maria: I'll draft a short doc for binary args (Node vs browser) and add test matrix.
ryan: adding tests for nested arrays/objects and for already-base64 path to avoid regressions.
jane: passing ETA and workaround to customer, will close when 1.4.2 is released.
support-bot: Thread closed by jane (pending release confirmation).
